title: Payload — moderation.report_created
$comment: A request, not a verdict. Feeds a moderator's queue; changes nothing about display. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
